extends: evidence/increment2b/CORRECTIONS.json (R1-R9; that file is hash-bound in increment2b/SUMMARY.json and is left byte-identical)
scope: Scoped corrections after the revision-2 inspection review of head 02847b575cd350abfd675720ed4d8d3f7d95ab24. A correction applies only to its named claim and scope.

corrections.claim: BUILD_SPEC Increment 2B revalidation bullet: 'a fixed high-support gap fails there too'.
corrections.finding: The HIGH_SUPPORT_UNSHIFTED_SLICE measurement is on one exact support, reduced indices >= split + 1 for even parity and >= split for odd parity (|n| > split), at split 128 (L=4), 312 (L=5) and 648 (L=6), with the reconstructed constant 1/4. Its exact Rayleigh witnesses show only that Q_p >= (1/4)||x||^2 is false on that support at those states.
corrections.repair: The statement now reads: the quarter law is FALSIFIED_BOUND on the support |n| > split at the named splits. It does not falsify a historical certificate on a narrower support, a higher support threshold, a different constant or a different aperture; the historical support and constant are still not imported, so no historical certificate is reproduced or refuted.
corrections.records_unchanged: evidence/increment2b high_support_test records already state 'reduced indices >= %d (|n| > split)'; no record is regenerated.

corrections.claim: Increment 2B/3B workflow summary (chat and an earlier PR-body wording): every intermediate-head CI failure was a cancellation caused by a later push.
corrections.finding: All intermediate-head failures but one were cancellations. The exception was genuine: rhkg-compiler-receipt at 94cb6d8 failed on stale generated products.
corrections.repair: WORKFLOW_HARVEST records the genuine failure separately from the cancellations; the regenerated-products commit 02847b5 addresses it, and its own exact-head run decides whether it did.

corrections.claim: Bookkeeping: the revision-2 build was reported in chat as 11 commits.
corrections.finding: The revision-2 build on research/madness consists of 10 commits, 54ef598 through 02847b5 inclusive (parent c27abd8). No committed file stated 11.
corrections.repair: No file change needed beyond this record.

limitations_restated.level_3: Level-3 reconstructions use their own elimination basis and Schur certificate but share native_source.py, the equation-(4.4) backend and the Arb primitives with the engine. They are not level 4; FiniteCertificateSoundness and the native enclosure bridge remain OPEN.
limitations_restated.near_band: E-D1 near-band counts and coupling masses use floating spectral projectors (EXPERIMENTAL SIGNAL). Increment 3C adds projector-free certified upper bounds; floating projections remain labelled as such.
limitations_restated.source_ledger: Folder coverage means every connector-returned item is listed; 204 of 206 entries remain DISCOVERED. Listing is not text review, proof audit or replay.
